recent.title: Regular Session
recent.text: Thank you, Mr. President. Mr. President, on the eighth day God looked down on this planned paradise and he said, I need a caretaker. So God made a farmer. God said, I need somebody willing to get up before dawn, milk cows, work all day in the fields, milk cows again, eat supper, then go down and stay past midnight at the meeting of the local school board. So God, Mr. President, gave me a son. God…
